reasoning: This trial comparing XELOX vs FOLFOX in stage IV gastric carcinoma failed due to operational issues rather than mechanistic problems. The investigator explicitly noted 'poor enrollment of patients' with only 42 patients enrolled over the study period. No primary endpoint results, effect sizes, or p-values were reported, indicating the trial was likely terminated early or underpowered. Both regimens are established chemotherapy combinations with known mechanisms (DNA synthesis inhibition via fluoropyrimidines and platinum agents), so the failure appears to be execution-related rather than biological. The small sample size (42 patients) would be insufficient to detect meaningful differences in progression-free survival between two active chemotherapy regimens.
